expectedInvestigation.uncertainty: The baseline observations identify four local invariant violations; no patch has been proposed or verified.

hypotheses.nextCheck: Run the cart regression after clamping the resulting quantity and removing zero-quantity items.

hypotheses.statement: calculateDisplayedCartTotal applies the already-calculated discount a second time.
hypotheses.nextCheck: Compare displayedTotalCents with totalCents for a cart with one valid coupon.

hypotheses.nextCheck: Evaluate the coupon at a fixed time after expiresAt and require rejection.
